faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Guwahati Associate Project Scientist position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Associate Project Scientist post at IIT Guwahati is 14th August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.Tech./B.E. or M.Tech./M.E. in specific engineering or science disciplines like Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Nanotechnology, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or Physics. For B.Tech./B.E., 3 years of experience is also required.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided data, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Associate Project Scientist role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 35,000 to Rs. 42,000.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Associate Project Scientist post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Associate Project Scientist position at IIT Guwahati.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Associate Project Scientist position at IIT Guwahati will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Associate Project Scientist position is contractual.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Guwahati located?
faq.answer: IIT Guwahati is located in Guwahati, Assam, with the pincode 781039.

faq.question: Q9. When is the interview scheduled for the shortlisted candidates?
faq.answer: The interview for shortlisted candidates is scheduled to be held on 24th August 2026.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: You can apply online through the official website of IIT Guwahati or via the direct application link provided in the 'Important Links' section before the last date of 14th August 2026.
